zero_step_note: the +4.9 mmHg sealed-zero step seen at 10:17 was cleared by an MCU reset at ~11:08 without touching temperature, tubing or the sensor. That is evidence for an MCU/power-up state contribution, not for a thermal offset; the DHT11 route was therefore dropped for this batch (see data/protocols/reference_bp_batch_crosstday_v1.md §2.3, hand-recorded temperature).
zero_arc_note: the +4.9 mmHg step at 10:17 is explained by a loose sensor wire, not by temperature: an MCU reset dropped it to -0.29, two pressure cycles pushed it back to +1.8, and reseating the wire at 11:54 dropped it to -0.95. Temperature was dropped from the card at the operator's request (no one-decimal thermometer available); the protocol asks for a hand-recorded value, so the field stays null with this note.
no_temperature_reason: operator has no thermometer with one-decimal resolution; the field is left null and the zero_arc above records what actually moved the zero instead.
